entities.summary: Amaal Mallik is an Indian music director, composer, and singer who works primarily in Hindi cinema. He made his debut as a film composer with Jai Ho and gained wider recognition with the song "Sooraj Dooba Hain," which achieved commercial success and contributed to his emergence as a notable composer in Hindi Cinema.
